metadata.title: Synthetic health records and agent event windows for 'Intelligence Is Structure, Not Scale' (connectome substrate study)
metadata.description: Two synthetic corpora of 20,000 rows each, generated with seed 20260920 for the connectome substrate study 'Intelligence Is Structure, Not Scale: A Whole Central Nervous System Connectome as a Fixed Substrate for Scoring Health Data Trust'. DTI: every record's text, scoring context, generator knobs and 65-float feature vector, with the deployed Data Trust Index engine's labels (eight dimensions, composite, tier, flags) for all 20,000 records at engine commit e4785726 with the clock frozen at 2026-09-20T00:00:00Z, the train/val/test split, a flag on the 300 records scored by the four language-model arms, and the DTI-trained parameters of the five seed-1 arms (fly wiring, degree-preserving shuffle, random graph, parameter-matched network, ridge readout). BII: every event window's events and 58-float feature vector with the split. The BII scores and gates, the BII-trained parameters and the BII feature specification are held: the Behavioral Integrity Index scorer is unpublished work; its outputs and the models trained on them are held until it is. The teacher engines are not released. Every record is synthetic; no real person's data was used. Files, columns, generation and loading are documented in README.md; sha256 of every file in MANIFEST.json.
metadata.notes: Every record is synthetic; no real person's data was used. Released: all 20,000 DTI records, features and engine labels, the DTI-trained seed-1 parameters, all 20,000 BII windows and features. Held: BII scores and gates, BII-trained parameters and the BII feature specification, because the Behavioral Integrity Index scorer is unpublished work; its outputs and the models trained on them are held until it is. The DTI and BII teacher engines are not released. isDerivedFrom: none; the records are generated by code from a seed, not derived from any dataset. DTI and BII score data records and software-agent behaviour; they do not diagnose, treat, or make recommendations about any patient.
